findings: Highlight Substring Pitfall: Russian patronymics ('Иванович') contain Russian surnames ('Иванов') as prefixes. Single-token queries must preserve direct substring matching while multi-token queries perform word-token and fuzzy matching.
Phone Prefix Normalization: +7 and 8 formats must compare the 10-digit national core to highlight and score consistently regardless of prefix formatting.

Multi-Field Duplicate Detection: Prior code only checked patient fullName, completely ignoring phone. With findPotentialDuplicates, typing a phone first or typing a typo name with matching phone produces immediate duplicate warnings.
Non-Blocking Ergonomics: Added 'Выбрать эту карту' and 'В новом окне' 1-click CTAs adhering to Mandate 8e without blocking alerts or modals.
